cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Midstream & LNG lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +1.04%; weakest is Midstream & LNG at +0.03%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.
